model_summary: Binary classification model predicting customer churn for a telecommunications company.
intended_use: Demonstration of the Atlas DataFlow publisher release flow. Predicts whether a customer will churn (cancel service) based on account and service attributes.
limitations: Model is assembled for demonstration purposes within the Atlas DataFlow first real release candidate cycle.
Predictions reflect patterns in the training dataset and should not be used for production customer-facing decisions without independent validation.
No sensitive personal data, raw model weights, or private training pipeline details are included in this public artifact.
data_notes: Public-safe model card for the telco-customer-churn first real release candidate. Raw training data, private preprocessing steps, and model internals are excluded.
